title: A general framework for inequalities on simple graphs
summary: A general framework is developed for deriving sharp inequalities on simple graphs from majorization and Schur-convexity. After establishing majorization relations between the spectrum of an arbitrary graph and the spectra of the complete, complete bipartite, and matching graphs, it is shown that every positive Schur-convex spectral functional yields several sharp inequalities relating $λ_1$, $|λ_n|$, and $\|G\|_\ast$.
